responsibility: This header implements a reusable template for shortest-path computation over GCC’s directed graph abstractions. Given graph traits exposing node and edge vectors, it runs Dijkstra-style traversal from a chosen origin or toward a chosen target, records per-node minimum distances and predecessor/successor edges, and reconstructs shortest paths as caller-specified Path_t objects. Its role is generic graph-analysis infrastructure, including timing attribution via TV_ANALYZER_SHORTEST_PATHS, for GCC subsystems that need path lengths or explicit paths over custom graph types.
